subject: Finalizing MAP roadmap & sponsor escalation — Finova close playbook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finova.com>
Cc: Michael Tate <michael.tate@finova.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP draft for Finova — alignment on sponsor & timeline

Hi Elena,

Attaching an updated MAP (Finova_MAP_v2.pdf) that reflects the pilot timeline and deliverables we discussed. Key asks for this week:

- Can you confirm Michael Tate as executive sponsor and his preferred weekly check-in cadence?
- Are procurement milestones (PO, SOW) on track for early February?
- Finova requested a temporary SLA uplift for the pilot window — please confirm if we should submit an official escalation.

Proposed cadence: weekly 30-minute sync, Fridays @ 10am PT starting week of Jan 18. Action owners are inline in the MAP draft.

If that works, I’ll schedule the recurring and open a priority support ticket to begin the SLA review.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Finova_MAP_v2.pdf
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finova.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Tate <michael.tate@finova.com>, Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@procure-finova.com>
Date: 2027-01-11T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft for Finova — alignment on sponsor & timeline

Kim — thanks for this. Michael is confirmed as exec sponsor and wants weekly checkpoints; Fridays are fine. He also asked me to push for a temporary SLA exception for the pilot (Feb 1–28) because the pilot supports a time-sensitive regulatory submission.

Procurement: Alicia is our procurement lead (cc’d). We will aim to have a PO in 2–3 weeks but can expedite if required. For the SLA exception, Michael has asked us to request a dedicated on-call rotation and an elevated support SLO for the pilot period. Can Redwood provide a proposed scope and estimated incremental cost for a 24/7 rotation for February?

Also: can you attach SOC2 evidence for our compliance review?

— Elena
Elena Rossi
Director, Integrations — Finova Health
elena.rossi@finova.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finova.com>, Michael Tate <michael.tate@finova.com>, Alicia Perez <alicia.perez@procure-finova.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T15:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft for Finova — proposed owners & support escalation

Thanks Elena — looping in the right internal owners. Quick plan:

Action items (proposed):
- Open priority support ticket to evaluate temporary SLA uplift (Owner: Rishi) — Target: Jan 20
- Provide SOC2 attestation and compliance packet (Owner: Grace) — Target: Jan 15
- Confirm PO path & procurement contacts (Owner: Kimberly) — Target: Jan 25
- Schedule recurring Friday check-ins, first on Jan 22 (Owner: Kimberly) — Calendar invite to follow

Rishi — please flag dependencies (hardware, engineering on-call, escalation budget). We will need a short runbook if 24/7 rotation is required.

Kim — I attached the annotated MAP in the shared doc (link in related links) and noted the canary plan inside.

-Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finova.com>
Date: 2027-01-20T08:50:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft for Finova — priority support ticket opened

Opened SUP-12345 (public link in related links) to request temporary SLA uplift and 24/7 rotation coverage for the Feb pilot. Summary of ask sent to infra:

- Pilot period: 2027-02-01 to 2027-02-28
- Coverage: dedicated 24/7 on-call for critical incidents, 30-minute P1 response, daily health checks
- Scope: hosted API endpoints used in evaluation-only mode; no inference quotas beyond pilot baseline unless agreed in writing

Questions for procurement/prod: have we budget approval guardrails for on-call rotation incremental cost, or should we present options (basic/standard/premium)?

Attachments shared with Finova on request: SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf

-Rishi

Elena

Date: 2027-02-14T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Roadmap close playbook — executive checkpoint & outcome (SLA exception approved for pilot)

Team / Elena / Michael —

This is the executive checkpoint following our weekly MAP cadence. Quick summary and state as of today:

Status snapshot:
- SLA exception for pilot (Feb 1–28) has been approved for the requested coverage: 24/7 on-call, 30-minute P1 target. Incremental cost will be invoiced under DEAL-1427-FIN line item.
- Support ticket SUP-12345 updated; evidence bundle attached (support_ticket_12345.pdf).
- SOC2 evidence delivered (SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf).
- Procurement: Alicia confirmed PO issuance on Feb 4; finance will route the invoice on receipt.

Action items & owners (next 7 days):
- Confirm final runbook & escalation path (Owner: Rishi) — Due: 2027-02-16
- Exchange signed SOW addendum to reflect SLA exception (Owner: Kimberly) — Due: 2027-02-18
- Local enablement session for Finova platform team (Owner: Grace) — Due: 2027-02-20
- Weekly exec sync (standing) — Fridays 10am PT — Owner: Michael / Kimberly

Notes: please use the SUP-12345 ticket for incident comms during the pilot. I’ve included the Doc link with the finalized MAP (see related_links). If any of the owners above cannot meet their deadlines, flag here immediately so we can escalate to the executive sponsor.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a successful pilot.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: support_ticket_12345.pdf; SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf
